description: Low-frequency oscillator giving sine, triangle, sawtooth and square at once, meant for modulation rather than for listening

params.text: Switches the outputs between -5V to 5V and 0-10V; the swing from peak to peak is 10V either way
Turns the output upside down, keeping it inside the same voltage range
Sets the rate, from one cycle every four minutes to about 1000Hz; with a clock patched it multiplies the clock rate instead, at 1x in the middle of its travel
Scales the FM input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Sets the width of the square wave's high portion, 50% in the middle of its travel
Scales the PWM input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed

inputs.text: Adds to the rate by an amount set by the FM knob
A rising edge restarts the phase of every wave
Moves the width of the square wave by an amount set by the PWM knob
A clock patched here sets the rate, which the FREQ knob then multiplies or divides; the phase is left alone

outputs.text: The square wave, its width set by the pulse width controls

inputs.4: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
